scope.summary: Implement the conditional action: evaluate a boolean expression over StudioVariables and branch into distinct action lists; conditionals and multiple chained actions compose so one trigger runs a small runtime program. Expression evaluation MUST be deterministic and side-effect-scoped to variables and navigation, and expression/alias cycles are validation errors (MT-351). The conditional editor is an operator surface.

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: [STU-PRO-026] Conditional actions evaluate a boolean expression over variables and branch into distinct action lists; conditionals and multiple chained actions compose so one trigger can run a small runtime program. Expression evaluation MUST be deterministic and side-effect-scoped to variables and navigation, and expression/alias cycles are validation errors ([STU-DS-026]). ### 10. Motion Timeline (StudioMotionTimeline) The motion timeline is Studio's frame-by-frame animation authoring surface, complementing state-to-state prototype transitions with explicit keyframes, tracks, motion paths, and playback. It is one engine with the interactive-document animation surface ([STU-PRO-040d]), sharing the easing catalog and keyframe model.

[STU-PRO-025] Set-variable ([STU-PRO-015]) and conditional ([STU-PRO-026]) actions evaluate runtime expressions over `StudioVariable`s: arithmetic on number variables, string concatenation, comparisons, and boolean logic, including reading mode-specific values. The variable, collection, and mode primitives are exactly those in 14.10 ([STU-DS-022] through [STU-DS-028]); prototyping does not define a separate variable type.

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.

patch_provenance.preserved: The original acceptance prose is kept verbatim at scope.acceptance_criteria_original. No clause, scope decision, path list or obligation from the original contract was removed.
